title: fix(ios): chat hides narration after a run finishes
body:
Related: #180490

## What Problem This Solves

Completed native chat turns hide assistant narration inside one work disclosure. The reader loses the explanation between tool operations as soon as the final answer arrives.

## User Impact

The iOS and macOS chat surfaces keep narration and media inline in source order. Only contiguous tool and reasoning work folds into separate disclosures. Loading older history preserves expanded sections, including work before a steer message. Active or unanswered work remains expanded.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared chat presentation projects mixed envelopes without changing stored history or the message identities used by copy, reply, speech, and reactions. Markdown and reasoning-sensitive envelopes retain their parser context; tool outcomes and source previews stay attached to the correct part. Disclosure identity follows the surviving visible boundary rather than the first loaded work row.

Original implementation and regression work by @Marvinthebored; contributor commits are retained.

## Evidence

Exact-head CI [40593802679](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40593802679) is green; `openclaw/ci-gate` passed for a0e7c6aaf147.

- The production transcript projection on main hides both earlier narration segments; the regression fails there and passes with the fix.
- Prepending actual tool work changes disclosure identity on the original candidate; the repaired boundary anchor preserves it, including steer continuations.
- All 82 tests in eight focused Swift suites pass inside an OS sandbox with a private home and state directory. No native application was launched.
- Production Swift lint, changed projection formatting, docs formatting, generated native string inventory, and diff checks pass. A broader formatting scan reproduces existing indentation/trailing-space errors in the demo transport on main. An optional whole-file test lint scan finds pre-existing snapshot-test style/size violations; those tests are not in the configured iOS production lint scope.
- Initial published diff: production +221, tests/fixtures +867. Current diff: production +220, tests/fixtures +444, docs +1, generated inventory +2. The remaining production growth preserves original actions, tool-result pairing, and mixed-envelope rendering without rewriting history.
- Independent Codex review: no actionable P0–P2 findings.
- Contributor simulator captures below show the synthetic before/after presentation. Final-head simulator and real Gateway round trips were not run on the operator desktop; focused sandboxed tests provide local native proof and PR CI provides broad checks.
